fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local reporting on Miami and Miami Beach politics, including debate over water-rate increases and proposed consolidation of city and county tax assessor functions, with discussion of recall procedures and the political fallout involving H. Leslie Quigg and Mayor Wolfarth. Features a major critique of legal gambling and racetracks as drivers of corruption and human misery, and an editorial alleging a cold-blooded police killing of a Black man in "Colored Town" and calling for accountability. National policy coverage discusses Secretary of Labor Maurice J. Tobin's proposed $100-per-month pension plan and opposition from wealthy interests, alongside commentary on the "Welfare State." Additional items include complaints about hotels hiring outside contractors over Miami firms, court and vagrancy cases, and a report alleging federal funds for Seminoles are mishandled by Indian agents.
